# quoted text

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/quotedText>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The inline text a work quotes when the quoted content is a passage rather than a linkable resource. Non-functional: several quoted passages may appear.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the verbatim inline text a work quotes when the source is a bare passage with no linkable IRI; non-functional, so several passages may appear.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when the quoted content has its own resource (link it with [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md) instead) and avoid it for the body text of the work itself.

### How to use

- Attach the passage as a literal via [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md), ideally alongside [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md) pointing at the source when one exists.

### Examples

- ex:post [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md) "To be, or not to be.".
